_doc: Conservative price estimates per endpoint and quality, in USD per image (BRIEF 3.10). `per_image`: a flat price up to `base_pixels`, scaled by pixel count above. `table`: fal's listed output price per size; a request costs the dearest listed row at or below the smallest listed size that holds it (scaled by pixel count above the largest row), plus `prompt_allowance_usd` for prompt text tokens. Estimates are rounded up to $0.0001. An endpoint without an entry uses `fallback` (the sunburst figure). The budget stop sums max(estimate, billed) per request.

openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/text-to-im.source: BRIEF 3.10 and docs/concept/manifest.json: $0.07 an image at high quality up to 1536 x 864, fal's historical average. Lower qualities are priced as high (never below it); xhigh, max and auto scale by flare's listed quality ratios (auto can reach max).

openai/gpt-image-2.5/flare/text-to-image.source: fal model page for openai/gpt-image-2.5/flare/text-to-image, read 2026-10-21 (output cost per image; prompt text is extra at $5 per 1M tokens).
